name: Karasuba Yukari
source:
One of the two sub-heroines and [url=/c908]Haruki's[/url] homeroom teacher who doesn't want to get involved in troublesome things. Even though she's not good at smoking, she's always carrying around a pack of cigarettes.

[Edited from Mayoi's review]
